[[File:Icon-starship.png|40px]]

A '''Starship''' is a [[Star Wars CCG]] card type that deploys to a system or sector. Subtypes are [[Starfighter]] (maneuver) and [[Capital]] (armor). Do not confuse this with [[Starship Weapon]].

Premiere examples: [[Millennium Falcon]], [[X-wing]], [[Corellian Corvette]], [[Devastator]].
